items.title: First Batch of NDA-Trained Women Cadets Commissioned as Officers
items.whyInNews: The first batch of women cadets trained at the National Defence Academy (NDA) has been commissioned as officers in the Indian Armed Forces. This historic event took place on June 14, 2026.
items.summary: The commissioning of the first batch of NDA-trained women cadets marks a significant milestone in the history of the Indian Armed Forces. The ceremony was attended by senior officials and dignitaries, including the Defence Minister. The newly commissioned officers will be serving in various branches of the Indian Armed Forces, including the Army, Navy, and Air Force.

items.title: New York Knicks Win NBA Title
items.whyInNews: The New York Knicks have won the NBA title, defeating the San Antonio Spurs in the finals. Jalen Brunson scored a game-high 45 points, leading the Knicks to a 4-1 series victory.
items.summary: The New York Knicks have secured their first NBA title in 53 years, defeating the San Antonio Spurs in the finals. Jalen Brunson's impressive performance, scoring 45 points, contributed to the Knicks' 4-1 series win. The team's victory has sparked celebrations in New York, with fans rejoicing in the streets.
